description: This file implements hash-to-curve functions as specified in draft-irtf-cfrg-hash-to-curve-16, including message expansion, hashing to field elements, and mapping to elliptic curve points for P-256 and P-384 curves using the Simplified Shallue-van de Woestijne-Ulas (SSWU) method.

methods.name: expand_message_xmd
methods.description: Implements the expand_message_xmd function from draft-irtf-cfrg-hash-to-curve-16, used for hashing messages to a uniform byte string.

methods.name: num_bytes_to_derive
methods.description: Calculates the number of bytes needed to hash to a field element or scalar based on the modulus size.

methods.name: big_endian_to_words
methods.description: Converts a big-endian byte array into an array of BN_ULONG words.

methods.name: hash_to_field2
methods.description: Hashes a message to two field elements using the specified hash function.

methods.name: hash_to_scalar
methods.description: Hashes a message to a scalar modulo the group order.

methods.name: map_to_curve_simple_swu
methods.description: Maps a field element to a point on the elliptic curve using the simplified SWU method.

methods.name: hash_to_curve
methods.description: Hashes a message to an elliptic curve point using the hash-to-curve method.

methods.name: felem_from_u8
methods.description: Creates a field element from a single byte.
